"""Independent Decimal110 signed decomposition of saved affine-port errors."""
from decimal import Decimal, localcontext
import csv, json, pathlib, time
import numpy as np
R=pathlib.Path('/home/fenics/Projects/NN-Lab-V2');T=R/'docs/task042extra_feinn_5nm/outcomes/records'
started=time.monotonic();raw=json.loads((R/'tmp/task42extra/review_v21_raw_audit.json').read_text());rows=[]
def D(x):return Decimal.from_float(float(x))
def cv(x):return [D(x.real),D(x.imag)]
def ary(x):return np.array([complex(float(r),float(i)) for r,i in x])
def norm(x):return float(np.linalg.norm(x))
def minus(x,y):return [[a-c,b-d] for (a,b),(c,d) in zip(x,y)]
def plus(x,y):return [[a+c,b+d] for (a,b),(c,d) in zip(x,y)]
for role,rec in raw['roles'].items():
    with np.load(rec['files']['native']['path']) as z:a={k:z[k] for k in ('dp','dr','dv','H','gp','background','background_alpha')}
    with np.load(rec['files']['field']['path']) as z:s={k:z[k] for k in z.files}
    with np.load(rec['files']['observables']['path']) as z:keys=z['mode_keys'];zs=z['mode_boundary_z']
    with np.load(rec['files']['port_vectors']['path'] if 'port_vectors' in rec['files'] else pathlib.Path(rec['files']['field']['path']).with_name('port_recovery_vectors.npz')) as z:vec={k:z[k] for k in z.files}
    alpha_rows=[r for r in csv.DictReader((T/'alpha_recovery_modes_v21.csv').open()) if r['role']==role]
    assert len(alpha_rows)==340
    for r in alpha_rows:
        key=[r[k] for k in ('side','m','n','polarization')];j=np.flatnonzero(np.all(keys==key,axis=1))[0]
        assert float(r['reference_z_nm'])==zs[j]
        for k in ('alpha_lu_raw','alpha_old_backsub','alpha_recovered'):assert complex(float(r[k+'_real']),float(r[k+'_imag']))==vec[k][j]
    with localcontext() as ctx:
        ctx.prec=110
        c={k:[cv(v) for v in s[k]] for k in ('c_scattered','background','c_total')}
        sums={k:[[Decimal(0),Decimal(0)] for _ in a['H']] for k in c}
        for j,i,z in zip(a['dp'],a['dr'],a['dv']):
            dr,di=cv(z)
            for k in c:
                cr,ci=c[k][i];sums[k][j][0]+=dr*cr-di*ci;sums[k][j][1]+=dr*ci+di*cr
        proj={k:[[r/D(h),i/D(h)] for (r,i),h in zip(v,a['H'])] for k,v in sums.items()}
        gp=[[r/D(h),i/D(h)] for (r,i),h in zip(map(cv,a['gp']),a['H'])]
        exacts=plus(proj['c_scattered'],gp);exactb=proj['background'];exactt=proj['c_total']
        ass=[cv(z) for z in s['alpha_scattered']];abb=[cv(z) for z in s['background_alpha']];att=[cv(z) for z in s['alpha_total']]
        assert np.array_equal(ary(exacts),s['alpha_scattered']);assert np.array_equal(ary(exactb),s['background_alpha'])
        diff=minus(exactt,att)
        parts=dict(coefficient_addition=minus(exactt,plus(proj['c_scattered'],exactb)),scattered_port_rounding=minus(exacts,ass),background_port_rounding=minus(exactb,abb),port_addition_rounding=minus(plus(ass,abb),att),port_rhs=[[-r,-i] for r,i in gp])
        summation=[[Decimal(0),Decimal(0)] for _ in diff]
        for part in parts.values():summation=plus(summation,part)
        res=ary(minus(diff,summation));dn=norm(ary(exactt));difference=ary(diff);j=int(np.argmax(abs(difference)))
        unrounded_affine=plus(proj['c_scattered'],exactb)
        ctround=ary(minus(c['c_total'],plus(c['c_scattered'],c['background'])))
        result=dict(role=role,total_recovery_relative=norm(ary(exactt)-s['alpha_total'])/dn,
                    signed_exact_gap_norm=norm(difference),expected_total_alpha_norm=dn,coefficient_rounding_norm=norm(ctround),coefficient_rounding_relative=norm(ctround)/norm(s['c_total']),
                    parts={k:dict(norm=norm(ary(v)),relative_to_expected_total=norm(ary(v))/dn,signed_projection_on_gap=float(np.vdot(difference,ary(v)).real/(norm(difference)**2))) for k,v in parts.items()},
                    decomposition_closure_relative=norm(res)/max(norm(difference),1e-300),worst_key=keys[j].tolist(),
                    formal_unrounded_affine_projection_vs_saved_alpha=norm(ary(unrounded_affine)-s['alpha_total'])/norm(ary(unrounded_affine)),
                    scope='Diagnostic exact linear functional on saved binary64 D/H only. No new stored field, no change of Gate, no proof of physical quadrature or full target.',
                    unchanged_saved_coefficients=True)
        rows.append(result)
out=dict(schema='review_v21.affine_decomposition.v1',rows=rows,alpha_csv_verified=1020,arithmetic='independent Decimal110; no producer recovery call',no_FE_solve_factor_training=True,worker_seconds=time.monotonic()-started)
(R/'tmp/task42extra/review_v21_affine_audit.json').write_text(json.dumps(out,indent=2)+'\n');print(json.dumps(out,indent=2))

"""Analytic polynomial/Fourier witness. No mesh/FE import or operator assembly."""
import csv,json,pathlib,time
import numpy as np
from scipy.special import spherical_jn,eval_legendre
from numpy.polynomial.legendre import leggauss
R=pathlib.Path('/home/fenics/Projects/NN-Lab-V2');T=R/'docs/task042extra_feinn_5nm/outcomes/records';start=time.monotonic()
design=json.loads((R/'input/task042extra_feinn_5nm/design_v20.json').read_text())
cases=[]
for label,p,model,phase in [('AIR8_O6',6,design['fixture'],False),('G0_E3',3,design['models']['G0'],True),('G0_E4',4,design['models']['G0'],True),('GX560_O6',6,design['models']['GX560'],False)]:
    axes=model['geometry']['axis_coordinates_nm'];bounds=model['geometry']['bounds_nm'];k0=2*np.pi/model['wavelength_nm'];theta=np.deg2rad(model['incidence']['grazing_deg']);phi=np.deg2rad(model['incidence']['azimuth_deg'])
    inc=k0*np.cos(theta)*np.array([np.cos(phi),np.sin(phi)])
    kappa=inc if phase else np.zeros(2)
    rows=[]
    for axis,maxkey in [(0,model['boundary']['max_m']),(1,model['boundary']['max_n'])]:
        L=bounds[axis][1]-bounds[axis][0]
        for h in sorted(set(np.round(np.diff(axes[axis]),14))):
            for mode in range(-maxkey,maxkey+1):
                z=(inc[axis]+mode*2*np.pi/L-kappa[axis])*h/2
                for ell in range(p+1):
                    exact=2*(1j**ell)*spherical_jn(ell,complex(z))
                    vals=[]
                    for n in (8,16,32):
                        x,w=leggauss(n);vals.append(np.dot(w,eval_legendre(ell,x)*np.exp(1j*z*x)))
                    rows.append(dict(axis=axis,h_nm=h,mode=mode,ell=ell,phase_halfspan=z,exact=[exact.real,exact.imag],q15_abs=float(abs(vals[0]-exact)),q30_abs=float(abs(vals[1]-exact)),q62_abs=float(abs(vals[2]-exact))))
    cases.append(dict(case=label,count=len(rows),worst_q15=max(rows,key=lambda r:r['q15_abs']),max_q30_abs=max(r['q30_abs'] for r in rows),max_q62_abs=max(r['q62_abs'] for r in rows),worst_m6=max((r for r in rows if r['axis']==0 and r['mode']==6),key=lambda r:r['q15_abs'],default=None)))
raw=json.loads((R/'tmp/task42extra/review_v21_raw_audit.json').read_text());counts=0
obs={}
for role,rec in raw['roles'].items():
    with np.load(rec['files']['observables']['path']) as z:obs[role]={k:z[k] for k in ('mode_keys','mode_boundary_z','total_projection','scattered_projection','outgoing_origin','outgoing_boundary')}
for r in csv.DictReader((T/'mode_errors_v21.csv').open()):
    aa,bb=r['pair'].split('_vs_');key=[r[k] for k in ('side','m','n','polarization')];a,b=obs[aa],obs[bb];ia=np.flatnonzero(np.all(a['mode_keys']==key,axis=1))[0];ib=np.flatnonzero(np.all(b['mode_keys']==key,axis=1))[0];u,v=a[r['family']][ia],b[r['family']][ib]
    assert complex(float(r['candidate_real']),float(r['candidate_imag']))==u
    assert complex(float(r['reference_real']),float(r['reference_imag']))==v
    assert float(r['reference_z_nm'])==b['mode_boundary_z'][ib]
    expected=dict(absolute=abs(u-v),original_reference_absolute=abs(v),denominator=max(abs(v),1e-12),relative=abs(u-v)/max(abs(v),1e-12))
    for k,x in expected.items():assert abs(float(r[k])-x)<=1e-13*max(abs(x),1e-24)
    counts+=1
regions=[]
rows=list(csv.DictReader((T/'regions_v21.csv').open()))
for r in rows:
    if r['pair']=='E3_vs_E4' and r['quantity']=='scattered_E':
        allrow=next(x for x in rows if x['pair']==r['pair'] and x['quantity']==r['quantity'] and x['region']=='all')
        regions.append(dict(region=r['region'],relative=float(r['relative']),error_squared_share=(float(r['absolute'])/float(allrow['absolute']))**2))
result=dict(schema='review_v21.analytic_face_moment_witness.v1',source='https://dlmf.nist.gov/10.54.E2',identity='integral(-1,1) P_l(t) exp(i z t) dt = 2 i^l j_l(z)',cases=cases,regions=regions,mode_csv_recomputed=counts,scope='Individual exact polynomial/Fourier moment witnesses at frozen physical phase spans. Nominal 8/16/32 Gauss points only; not a reconstruction of actual B/D/H and not an error estimate for saved fields.',FE_assembly_solve_factor_training=0,worker_seconds=time.monotonic()-start)
(R/'tmp/task42extra/review_v21_moment_audit.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2)+'\n');print(json.dumps(result,indent=2))

import hashlib, json, pathlib, re, subprocess, time
from datetime import datetime, timezone
R=pathlib.Path('/home/fenics/Projects/NN-Lab-V2')
out=R/'tmp/task42extra/review_v21_inventory.json'
rows=[]
for name in subprocess.check_output(['git','ls-files','-z'],cwd=R).decode().split('\0'):
    if not name: continue
    p=R/name
    if not p.is_file(): continue
    b=p.read_bytes()
    s=b.decode('utf-8',errors='replace') if b'\0' not in b[:8000] else ''
    rows.append(dict(path=name,bytes=len(b),sha256=hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest(),navigation=[x[:240] for x in s.splitlines() if re.match(r'^(#{1,4} |(?:async )?def |class )',x)]))
record=dict(schema='review.quick-repository-refresh.v1',head=subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],cwd=R,text=True).strip(),utc=datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),monotonic=time.monotonic(),scope='Read every tracked file byte; collect headings/definitions. This is quick refresh, not line-by-line semantic review.',files=rows)
out.write_text(json.dumps(record,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n')
idx=json.loads((R/'docs/task042extra_feinn_5nm/outcomes/records/run_index_v21.json').read_text())
print(json.dumps(dict(files=len(rows),bytes=sum(x['bytes'] for x in rows),inventory=str(out),runs=[dict(stage=x['stage'],source=x['source_sha'],artifacts=[a['path'] for a in x['artifacts'] if a['path'].endswith(('.npz','result.json','native_metadata.json'))]) for x in idx['runs']]),ensure_ascii=False,indent=2))
